name: Alchemist's Crown

effects.name: Wisdom
effects.tooltip: Wisdom +6 : This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +6 Enhancement bonus to Wisdom.

effects.name: Devotion
effects.tooltip: Devotion +72 : Passive: +72 Equipment bonus to Positive (Healing) Spell Power .

effects.name: Radiance
effects.tooltip: Radiance +72 : Passive: +72 Equipment bonus to Light and Alignment Spell Power .

effects.name: Nearly Finished - Alchemist's Lore
effects.tooltip: Alchemist's Lore : Reduces the cost of Empower, Empower Healing, and Maximize by 2 SP. Spells cost 10%/20%/30% less when you are below 50%/25%/10% hp.

flavor_text: House Cannith alchemists often don crowns such as this to grant them wisdom and foresight, allowing them to make decisions with greater clarity.

source.raw: House Cannith Manufactury , Tegan Darsit 's chest (Rare encounter)
